title: LLM Provider/Model Management UI Non-Functional
summary: The LLM provider and model management UI is non-functional due to a bug, preventing users from adding or editing providers/models through the admin interface.
root_cause: The saveLLMProvider and saveLLMModel functions are not exposed as global functions, causing the form submission to fail silently.
resolution: Changing the onsubmit attributes to use the Admin. prefix
impact_description: The entire LLM provider and model management UI is non-functional, affecting all deployments.
